Overall-survival analysis of a TCGA cohort

Source: R/tcga.R
tcga_survival.Rd

Downloads (or loads) a TCGA dataset, normalises it, stratifies patients into high and low expressers of a gene or signature (upper vs lower quartile), and runs a Kaplan-Meier overall-survival analysis.

Usage

tcga_survival(
  TCGA.dataset,
  gene.signature,
  gene.name = NULL,
  rda.file.path = NULL,
  plot.dir = "figures/",
  data.dir = "data/"
)

Arguments

TCGA.dataset

TCGA project id, e.g. "TCGA-LAML".

gene.signature

Gene, or vector of genes, defining the signature. With several genes the ranking score is the mean z-score (see stratify_by_expression()).

gene.name

Optional label (defaults to gene.signature).

rda.file.path

Optional path to a prepared .rda from download_tcga_rnaseq(); if NULL, the data are downloaded.

plot.dir

Directory to save the survival plot into.

data.dir

Directory for downloaded and normalised data.

Value

Invisibly, the clinical table with the Signature (High / Low) assignment. The survival plot is written to plot.dir.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tcga_survival("TCGA-LAML", gene.signature = "TLR2")
} # }
